# Riitu Institution

> Navi Mumbai's premier cohort-based Chartered Accountancy (CA) and Commerce coaching academy in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. Strictly 15 students per batch, taught 100% by practicing senior Chartered Accountants.

Riitu Institution is an elite commerce and Chartered Accountancy academy based in Sector 12, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai (2 minutes from Central Park Metro Station). Founded in 2012 by CA Deepak Jain and CA Ritu Jain, the institution pioneered the "Anti-Mass-Factory" model with a strict ceiling of 15 students per cohort to guarantee individualized mentorship, daily answer writing reviews, and deep conceptual clarity.

## Core Academic Programs

- [CA Foundation Cohort](https://riituinstitution.com/ca-foundation): Comprehensive preparation for ICAI CA Foundation (Jan & May exams). Features a proprietary 14-day Science-to-Commerce transition bridge, 100% senior CA mentorship, daily handwritten test assessments, and strict 15-student seating cap.
- [CA Intermediate (G1 & G2)](https://riituinstitution.com/ca-intermediate): Group 1 & Group 2 preparation with a verified 60%+ clearance record (vs. 15-20% national average). Taught exclusively by Big 4 alumnus CAs (ex-PwC, Deloitte). Includes 1,200+ case law reviews and 3 full-syllabus simulated mock test series.
- [11th & 12th Commerce Integrated](https://riituinstitution.com/commerce-11th-12th): Dual-track coaching covering Maharashtra State Board and CBSE syllabi alongside early foundation preparation for professional courses like CA, CS, and CMA.
- [CS Executive & CMA Preparation](https://riituinstitution.com/cs-cma): Comprehensive training for Company Secretary (CS Executive) and Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) credentials, with proven All India Rank (AIR 25) pedigree.
- [School Foundations (6th to 10th)](https://riituinstitution.com/school-6th-10th): Advanced mathematics and science coaching led by M.Sc Gold Medalist faculty for ICSE, CBSE, and Maharashtra State Board students.
- [College Degree Coaching (B.Com / BMS)](https://riituinstitution.com/college-bcom-bms): Targeted university curriculum exam preparation for Mumbai University B.Com and BMS undergraduates.
- [All Academic Programs Directory](https://riituinstitution.com/courses): Complete overview and comparison of all micro-cohort coaching programs.

## Key Differentiators & Institutional Facts

- **Strict 15-Seat Cap**: Zero 300-student commercial auditoriums. Every student receives personal 1:1 attention, individual doubt clearance, and tailored pace adjustment.
- **100% Senior Chartered Accountant Faculty**: All core professional subjects are taught exclusively by qualified Fellow CAs from top global firms (PwC, Deloitte, Disney). No junior teaching assistants or interns.
- **Proven 60%+ CA Clearance Rate**: Consistent academic clearance rates far exceeding the ICAI national average.
- **Zero-Fee Free Demo Class**: Prospective students and parents are invited to sit inside an actual 2-hour live classroom lecture (with enrolled students) and receive a 1:1 diagnostic consultation before committing fees.
- **Convenient Metro Location**: Physical learning center at Landmark CHS, Sector 12 Kharghar, situated 2 minutes walking distance from Central Park Metro Station.

## Faculty Leadership

- **CA Deepak Jain (FCA)**: Senior Fellow Chartered Accountant, ex-Big 4 (PwC, Deloitte) advisory specialist. Leads Financial Accounting, Auditing, and Direct Taxation with over a decade of mentorship.
- **CA Ritu Jain (FCA)**: Renowned commerce educator, Company Law and Corporate Governance authority with over 12 years of professional mentoring experience.
- [Faculty Credentials & Bios](https://riituinstitution.com/our-faculty): Complete backgrounds, credentials, and teaching philosophies of the mentoring team.
